title: Levels problem and chart card
description: A white section: on the left an eyebrow, a big medium-weight title, a long grey paragraph and a green arrow link; on the right (below on phones) a tall softly shadowed card with 30px corners, a pale green wash, a chart slot, a tiny tracked caption and a wrap of pill chips. Clicking a chip turns it ink-black and swaps the chart; chips brighten and their border darkens on hover.
notes: one chart per choice; the selected one shows. Empty: a pale wash placeholder of the chart's size
chip switching needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the first chart shows
the original's spike grows on entering view inside its chart; that motion belongs to the chart you pass in
